```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Bar Chart with Error Bars

```{r}
library(plotly.core)
library(plyr)

data_mean <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = mean(len))
data_sd <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = sd(len))
data <- data.frame(data_mean, data_sd$length)
data <- rename(data, c("data_sd.length" = "sd"))
data$dose <- as.factor(data$dose)

error_y <- go_error_bar(array = ~sd, color = "#000000")

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_bar(
    data = data[data$supp == "OJ", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    name = "OJ",
    error_y = error_y
  ) |>
  add_bar(
    data = data[data$supp == "VC", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    name = "VC",
    error_y = error_y
  )

fig
```

### Scatterplot with Error Bars

```{r}
library(plotly.core)
library(plyr)

data_mean <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = mean(len))
data_sd <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = sd(len))
data <- data.frame(data_mean, data_sd$length)
data <- rename(data, c("data_sd.length" = "sd"))
data$dose <- as.factor(data$dose)

error_y <- go_error_bar(array = ~sd, color = "#000000")

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    data = data[data$supp == "OJ", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    mode = "markers",
    name = "OJ",
    error_y = error_y
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    data = data[data$supp == "VC", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    mode = "markers",
    name = "VC",
    error_y = error_y
  )

fig
```

### Line Graph with Error Bars

```{r}
library(plotly.core)
library(plyr)

data_mean <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = mean(len))
data_sd <- ddply(ToothGrowth, c("supp", "dose"), summarise, length = sd(len))
data <- data.frame(data_mean, data_sd$length)
data <- rename(data, c("data_sd.length" = "sd"))
data$dose <- as.factor(data$dose)

error_y <- go_error_bar(array = ~sd, color = "#000000")

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    data = data[data$supp == "OJ", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = "OJ",
    error_y = error_y
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    data = data[data$supp == "VC", ],
    x = ~dose,
    y = ~length,
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = "VC",
    error_y = error_y
  )

fig
```

### Reference

See `go_error_bar()` for more information and chart attribute options!
